title: ChatGPT as Linguistic Equalizer? Quantifying LLM-Driven Lexical Shifts in Academic Writing

bias_targets.methodology: Difference-in-differences (DID) analysis comparing the lexical complexity (measured via the Measure of Textual Lexical Diversity, MTLD) of academic abstracts authored by Non-Native English Speakers (NNES) versus Native English Speakers (NES) before and after the release of ChatGPT.
